newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian central bank sells 5-, 13-wk bills, rates ease.
newsitem.headline: Croatian central bank sells 5-, 13-wk bills, rates ease.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 169.5 million kuna of five- and 13-week liquidity bills at slightly lower rates at a weekly auction.
It accepted bids for 152.5 million kuna in five-week bills at 7.97 percent, down two basis points from last week.
The 13-week rate also eased to 9.39 percent from 9.42 percent on volume of 22 million kuna.
There were no bids for 26-week paper, last issued at 17.50 percent two months ago. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
